subject: Problem with geom_boxplot width when using facet_grid

messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: Problem with geom_boxplot width when using facet_grid
parts:
Dear ggplot2 users

Please try the following code:

df <- expand.grid(y = rnorm(50), x1 = c('a', 'b'), x2 = c('a', 'b'))
df$y[df$x1 == 'a' & df$x2 == 'a'] <- NA
ggplot(df, aes(x = x1, y = y)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_grid(.~x2)

As you can see, the boxplot in the left panel has not the same width
as those in the right panel. I guess this is a bug because I did not
experience this problem in ggplot2 versions < 0.9.0.

Is there a workaround?

Kind regards,
Erich

messages.subject: Re: Problem with geom_boxplot width when using facet_grid
parts: You can work around it by setting width=0.9:

ggplot(df, aes(x = x1, y = y)) + geom_boxplot(width=0.9) + facet_grid(.~x2)

-Winston
